name: Topological Sort (Kahn's)
description: Orders vertices of a directed acyclic graph (DAG) so every directed edge u→v has u before v. Uses Kahn's BFS-based algorithm with in-degree tracking.
aim: Produce a linear ordering of vertices in a DAG such that for every directed edge (u,v), vertex u comes before v. Detect cycles as a side effect.
howItWorks: If result has fewer than V vertices, graph has a cycle

time.bestCase: Process every vertex and edge once
time.averageCase: BFS visits all vertices and edges

complexity.spaceDescription: In-degree array + queue hold O(V) elements

realWorld: Build systems — compile order of source files
alternatives: DFS-based topological sort — same complexity, different traversal
Kahns can detect cycles; DFS uses recursion stack
If cycle present, neither works — use SCC first
